verdict.rationale: FireHydrant Signals documents ingesting events from monitoring tools, including via a generic webhook event source with a defined Event Format. Teams define Alert Rules (CEL-based, with backtesting) that turn matching events into Alerts routed via escalation policies to team-owned on-call schedules. missing for 10: an enumerated list of specific named monitoring-tool integrations, independent or hands-on corroboration of routing accuracy.
